ideas.name: any warning with asset managers crowded long
ideas.why: asset managers' net long in the top fifth of the year: real money fully invested, with no buyer left behind dips, so rallies stall and turns pay

ideas.name: any warning against leveraged funds' fresh flip
ideas.why: in the week after trend followers flip their net side, they keep adding to the new side; a turn against that has their flow against it, so it fails
